On a friend's recommendation, I made my first appointment at this veterinary clinic in the middle of August for one of my cats' digestive issues, and I received excellent service! The veterinarian, a very gentle woman, took the time to reassure my pet and listen to my concerns to learn about his medical history. She put me at ease and gave me advice that aligned with my approach to my pet's well-being (appropriate diet, supplements, and medication). She demonstrated empathy and professionalism, which was truly appreciated!
The consultation fee was reasonable.

Hello. Just a quick call today about a hatchling tortoise.
The only clinic that was willing to help me was the one that took her in, cared for her, and offered to rehome her if all went well. I've known Dr. Schilliger for a very long time and I thank him and his staff again. My only regret is that he left Essonne!

He took the time to answer all my questions with clear explanations and valuable advice. He is fair and precise in his diagnoses. Gentle and friendly, I highly recommend him! A big thank you!

I am extremely grateful to Dr. Marie Lhubert, who operated on my Little Prince with professionalism and efficiency to extract several teeth. I also thank the entire team, who were very attentive and kind. The day after the operation, my little dog was already much better.
Attentive and very professional
Excellent veterinarian. Attentive and gentle.

Excellent veterinarian. Superb support from beginning to end, a very professional team, attentive and genuinely kind to animals. Their recommendations are always relevant and reassuring. You feel completely confident in their care; I highly recommend them.

First visit for my dog, adopted 3 weeks ago, who is timid. The staff was fantastic, a kind and patient young vet. I had an emergency 3 days later, late, after closing time, and their on-call system with an online vet is brilliant; they can even make a house call. Extremely reassuring and efficient. No complaints whatsoever: a really great practice. A keeper! 😀
Yesterday I received a very warm welcome from the entire ASV team and Dr. Leroy. I was very pleased with their kindness and efficiency. Thank you so much! 🥰🥰 …

I was going to make an appointment for my cat, but after reading the comments, it's out of the question. It's just a sterilization, and I don't want to get my cat back with problems they might have caused, because I have a strong feeling they invent or create problems for our animal friends for profit. I don't want to lose my cat, so I won't go.

Lionel is a great vet with extraordinary experience!! I learned so much from him!! He provides truly excellent care for animals with great sensitivity!! And I thank his wonderful team for their exemplary medical care!! @😇💕🦁🦏🐍 …

I received a very warm welcome and excellent advice at this veterinary clinic. They gave me initial advice over the phone for my cat, Ty Moon, and the diagnosis was already correct. They don't pressure me to buy anything, which is very reassuring.

I took my cat to this clinic several times because it was the closest to my home. The last time, he came home limping (he has access to the outdoors). The vet immediately diagnosed a ruptured Achilles tendon, took an X-ray, and told me it was obvious. She strongly urged me to have my cat operated on—major surgery with a difficult recovery and a very uncertain quality of life afterward. She was certain of her diagnosis, without a shadow of a doubt.

Fortunately, I wanted a second opinion. Another vet immediately told me it wasn't a tendon rupture at all. She took another X-ray and referred me to a veterinary hospital with a neurologist. There, the diagnosis was confirmed: cancer of the lymphatic system, with a tumor in the pelvis that was compressing the leg (which explained the limp). My cat then received palliative care at home and was able to pass away peacefully, without suffering.

I'm so glad I sought a second opinion, otherwise my cat would have undergone a major and unnecessary operation.

I understand that mistakes happen, but this one seems serious to me. The subsequent veterinarians examined the initial X-ray (I had photos) and confirmed that there was no rupture—the visible bone was simply a sesamoid bone, not a torn piece.

In short, I do not recommend this clinic. It wasn't the first time I'd received a somewhat dubious diagnosis there…

Avoid at all costs! A quack. I brought my cat in after he fell from my windowsill. The vet took an x-ray and told me he needed surgery in Neuilly (abdominal hernia - he could die from it)... I panicked and made an appointment. My husband was skeptical... so I went to another vet (Amivet on Rue de Versailles): "Madam, it's just a little bit of fat, your cat is a little chubby around the belly!"
I'm writing this review about 10 months later: my cat is doing very well and therefore absolutely did not need a €900 operation!
I could have done without this huge stress, as I had just given birth 3 days before!!! A very bad experience!!!!

I'm replying to your message below: by repeating twice that this vet has left, you confirm that someone incompetent worked at your clinic (thinking they could sweep the problem under the rug). If you choose to work with people who mistake abdominal hernias for adipose tissue (fat), it's no wonder the patient is completely dissatisfied, and that this reflects poorly on your clinic!

Dear animal lovers, if I have one piece of advice, it's to go to Amivet (just a few minutes away). They are very honest and competent.

Thank you, Dr. Schilliger, for your extraordinary expertise with our animal friends and your kindness towards them and their owners. We recently adopted a new dog and we feel completely at ease when we come to see you because we have total confidence in you. Thank you also to the assistants who are lovely and attentive.

We take our two dogs (a golden retriever and a French bulldog), who thankfully haven't had any serious health problems so far, for their vaccinations and to treat a few ear infections, as well as our two cats (one of whom can be a real tiger).

The welcome is warm and we feel our animals are safe.

I saw Dr. Schilliger for my  almost-16 year old Bichon, to get an EU passport and to get some kind of sedative for my dog who is petrified of flying.  Dr. Schilliger and his staff were kind and very patient with my rudimentary French and he gave Chester a medication that was perfect for him- our flight back to the United States was uneventful and our dog adjusted well to the medication.  His office also charged a reasonable fee compared to what we pay veterinarians in the United States and we are even thinking of using Dr. Schilliger as our primary veterinarian  since we go back and forth to Paris all the time (with our dog).  Highly recommended!

My tortoise had purulent otitis.
It was treated by Dr. Schillinger, whom I've been seeing and consulting for years at his various clinics. He has a great deal of empathy, offers excellent advice, and is extremely kind. Thank you for treating them for so many years.

Dr. Lionel Schilliger is a wonderful doctor who saved my hamster by operating on her. He's also very kind and generous. Thank you, Doctor. Ondine is doing great thanks to you!

Our grandmother's 19-year-old cat hadn't eaten for several days. Worried, we took him to this veterinarian who, after an examination, assured us everything was fine. Three days later, the cat was dying: mouth and eyes wide open, meowing in pain, body frozen. We thought he was dead, he was suffering so much.

We immediately called the clinic at 11:30 a.m. to request emergency euthanasia. The response: "Not before 4 p.m." Despite our insistence and the fact that he had been treating our cat for 19 years, there was no compassion, no solution. This is pure animal suffering, completely avoidable.

Fortunately, another veterinarian in Boulogne (whom I wholeheartedly recommend) agreed to see us as an emergency. He humanely ended our cat's suffering and said he was shocked by his colleague's attitude.

A veterinarian has a duty to act to prevent unnecessary suffering for an animal. This one absolutely failed to do so. A disgrace.

My dog ​​has been under the care of Dr. Schiliger and his team for four years now. The reception is always pleasant, the staff are genuinely concerned when Gus is sick, and they are very professional and compassionate.

No issues whatsoever, a friendly welcome and a competent veterinarian.

I recommend them.

No medication was given to relieve my dog's pain, and I was sent for multiple expensive tests at an overpriced private clinic in Boulogne… The risk isn't justified, but not everyone has €500 to spend on a heart exam to determine if a CT scan or MRI of the brain is necessary before providing any relief to the animal.
